name: SBIRS-HEO
tagline: US early-warning IR sensors hosted on classified Tundra-orbit platforms
description: The HEO segment of the US Space-Based Infrared System (SBIRS) — infrared missile-warning sensors hosted on classified host satellites in the 24-hour Tundra orbit at the 63.4° critical inclination. By dwelling at apogee over high latitudes, SBIRS-HEO covers the polar regions where geostationary DSP / SBIRS-GEO sensors look at too low an angle. SBIRS HEO-1 launched in 2006 as a hosted payload on USA-184.
best_known_for: HEO-segment IR early warning — covers polar latitudes the GEO sensors can't
